name: B10-0471/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a stronger, fairer partnership between the EU and the African Union ahead of their summit in Angola on 24–25 November 2025. It asks both sides to focus on fighting poverty, inequality and climate change, to involve parliaments and civil society, and to make sure EU investments in Africa respect human rights and do not add to African countries' debt. The text is the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament sets out demands for the EU-Africa summit.
- **Who it affects:** African and EU governments, citizens, businesses and civil society.
- **What happens next:** EU and African leaders meet in Luanda in November 2025.
